item.title: Ira Joe Johnson
item.description: Ira Joe Johnson, 93, passed away peacefully on January 19, 2026, in Springdale, Arkansas. Born on November 21, 1932, in Eureka Springs, Arkansas, he lived a long and meaningful life rooted in faith, family and service. The post Ira Joe Johnson appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: James “Tuba Jim” White
item.description: James “Tuba Jim” White of Eureka Springs, Arkansas was born June 26, 1947, in Belleville, Kansas to Lawrence and Mary (Jeardoe) White. James passed away January 25, 2026, in Eureka Springs at the age of 78. The post James “Tuba Jim” White appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Early voting begins next week
item.description: Early voting in the March 3 preferential primary and non-partisan judicial election will begin Tuesday, Feb. 17, and will continue through Monday, March 2. The post Early voting begins next week appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.
